text:
Maya (Design): quick check-in for the Private/VPC setup wizard network step. Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234. Goals: single 'Network readiness' page, clearer failure CTAs, prereq checks, and a11y fixes.

Leo (Product): looks good. request: make failure CTA explicit (e.g., 'Fix firewall rules') and show ETA per check (Expected: ~3 min).

Noor (Eng-Platform): agree. agent should run preflight probes and allow a persistent 'Re-run checks' button. checks: outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443, DNS, NTP, KMS.

Sam (SRE): add a collapsible 'Proxy / Egress' help panel with example env vars and curl-through-proxy tips for corp networks. Logs must be copy-safe.

Maya (Design): proposed failure copy: 'Network validation failed — required outbound access to api.redwood.ai:443. Click "How to fix" for instructions.' Banner short: 'Network validation failed — action required.'

Leo (Product): success text should be explicit: 'Network validated — ready to provision.'

Noor (Eng-Platform): UX nit: while checks run show spinner + 'Validating network...' disable Next but keep logs visible in a collapsible panel. Don't use a modal.

Sam (SRE): safe debug commands to show:
# test TLS
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/healthcheck
# test DNS
nslookup api.redwood.ai
Please redact ARNs/account IDs in UI.

infra-bot: Preflight queued: network-tls, dns-resolve, ntp-sync, kms-reach. Report: https://internal.redwood/checks/1748723456

Maya (Design): will update the frames with explicit CTAs, debug snippets, manual-setup toggle, and the a11y fixes (role="group", aria-describedby, focus to first error). Ping with :eyes: if you want notified when in staging.

Leo (Product): :eyes: ping me on staging.

Noor (Eng-Platform): +1 include telemetry names: private.setup.preflight.rerun and private.setup.manual.skip.

Sam (SRE): i'll draft firewall appendix and sample iptables entries for docs.

Maya (Design): thanks everyone, closing the loop.
